title: Data Scientist
description:
Senior Data Scientist - Risk & Advanced Modelling

Department: Data & Analytics
Duration: 3 months
Location: Remote

Role Purpose

This role will focus on designing and delivering advanced analytical models to support risk-based decision making, threat assessment, and complex data environments.

Working as part of a client-facing delivery team, you will develop and deploy data science solutions that enable organisations-particularly in regulated or life sciences environment's, to better understand risk, identify emerging threats, and drive evidence-based decisions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop risk models, predictive models, and scenario-based simulations
  • Build and deploy complex machine learning and statistical models in production environments
  • Apply data science techniques to threat detection, risk scoring, and anomaly detection
  • Work with large, complex, and often sensitive datasets (e.g. regulatory, clinical, operational)
  • Translate business and regulatory requirements into analytical models and frameworks
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis to uncover patterns, trends, and risks
  • Communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Collaborate with data engineers, architects, and domain experts to deliver end-to-end solutions

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in Python for data science (e.g. pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn)
  • Proven track record of building complex models (e.g. predictive, probabilistic, or simulation-based)
  • Experience with risk modelling, including:
    • Risk scoring frameworks
    • Predictive risk analytics
    • Scenario modelling
  • Experience of threat assessment or anomaly detection (e.g. fraud, safety, compliance, or security contexts)
  • Strong grounding in statistics, hypothesis testing, and experimental design
  • Experience working with large, messy, and heterogeneous datasets
  • Ability to turn complex outputs into clear, actionable insights

Desirable Experience

  • Experience in life sciences, healthcare, or regulated sectors (highly desirable)
  • Exposure to:
    • Clinical or pharmaceutical datasets
    • Regulatory environments
  • Experience with AI/ML platforms (e.g. Azure, Fabric, Databricks)
  • Knowledge of governance, compliance, or safety-critical systems
